# World Battery Hub — Manufacturer

> Battery manufacturer directory organized by region (China, US, Europe, India, Korea/Japan, and lithium/EV), with a product-verification framework. Sub-site of the World Battery Hub family.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/): Entry point to the manufacturer directory.
- [China Lead-Acid Manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/china-lead-acid-manufacturers/): Directory of Chinese lead-acid battery manufacturers.
- [US Battery Manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/us-battery-manufacturers/): Directory of US battery manufacturers.
- [European Battery Manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/european-battery-manufacturers/): Directory of European battery manufacturers.
- [Indian Battery Manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/indian-battery-manufacturers/): Directory of Indian battery manufacturers.
- [Korean & Japanese Battery Manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/korean-japanese-battery-manufacturers/): Directory of Korean and Japanese battery manufacturers.
- [Lithium & EV Manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/lithium-ev-manufacturers/): Directory of lithium and EV battery manufacturers.
- [Manufacturers](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/manufacturers/): Individual manufacturer profiles (via /manufacturers/[manufacturer]/).
- [Product Verification](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/product-verification/): Product/authenticity verification guidance.
- [Verification Criteria](https://manufacturer.worldbatteryhub.com/verification-criteria/): Criteria used to assess and verify manufacturers.

## Main site

- [World Battery Hub](https://worldbatteryhub.com/): Main knowledge hub (guides, tools, glossary, methodology).

## Notes

- Directory listings are reference compilations; verify manufacturer credentials, certifications, and product authenticity independently before procurement.
